description: Asset check that verifies an RPA asset ran successfully within SLA (freshness + terminal-success status + optional non-empty output).

target_asset.label: Target Asset
target_asset.description: Slash-separated asset key to check (e.g. 'uipath_invoice_extract' or 'rpa/uipath/invoices').

check_name.label: Check Name
check_name.description: Asset check name shown in the UI.

max_age_hours.label: Max Age Hours
max_age_hours.description: Fail if the latest materialization is older than this many hours.

expected_statuses.label: Expected Statuses
expected_statuses.description: Terminal-success values across RPA + scheduler vendors. Check passes if the asset's status metadata is in this list.

require_non_empty_output.label: Require Non Empty Output
require_non_empty_output.description: Also fail if output_payload.output_arguments (or output_payload.trigger_input) is empty.

name: RPA Health Check
